scenes.title: TETRANOODLE · REAL LOCAL DEMO
scenes.text: Five AI specialists. One calm group conversation. This recording uses live Groq replies and actual saved web research.

scenes.title: 01 · ONE TURN AT A TIME
scenes.text: Mira chooses a relevant speaker and one focused follow-up. The whole team does not ask competing questions.

scenes.title: 02 · FIVE DISTINCT RESPONSIBILITIES
scenes.text: Profile → discovery → official-source checks → application writing → final review. Each specialist contributes an artifact.

scenes.title: 03 · RAHUL’S FICTIONAL DOCUMENTS
scenes.text: These are real text PDFs. Extracted facts remain separate from assumptions. Rahul has no invented awards or project outcomes.

scenes.title: 04 · THE TEAM’S ACTUAL HANDOFFS
scenes.text: This workspace contains saved live agent messages and tool activity. Research can continue while the browser reconnects.

scenes.title: 04 · RESEARCH PROGRESS
scenes.text: Sources are actually fetched with Scrapling. Rate-limit retries and unavailable pages are shown honestly.

scenes.title: 05 · REAL OPPORTUNITIES
scenes.text: Top five is a research shortlist. Conditional eligibility and unknown funding are clearly labelled; scores are not admission probabilities.

scenes.title: 06 · ELIGIBILITY, WITH GAPS
scenes.text: The agent compares requirements with the student’s known facts. Missing language results, nationality or credits remain unknown.

scenes.title: 07 · CHECKABLE SOURCE EVIDENCE
scenes.text: Every retained detailed claim has an excerpt, official URL and retrieval date. An excerpt match proves provenance, not guaranteed eligibility.

scenes.title: 08 · COMPARE POSSIBILITIES
scenes.text: Compare funding, deadlines and fit side by side. The full report can be exported for review.

scenes.title: 09 · A DRAFT, NEVER A SUBMISSION
scenes.text: Leo prepares a source-specific application draft. Missing personal stories and achievements stay as placeholders.

scenes.title: 10 · A DIFFERENT STUDENT, SAME SYSTEM
scenes.text: Aisha studies economics and targets policy/development in Germany and the Netherlands. These are actual separate research results.

scenes.title: 10 · ADAPTATION AND EXCLUSIONS
scenes.text: The system changes its searches and criteria with the profile. All researched includes rejected and expired candidates, with reasons.

scenes.title: 11 · A CHAT THAT FITS THE SCREEN
scenes.text: The header and message box stay in place. Only the conversation scrolls. The same workspace works on a phone.

scenes.title: TETRANOODLE · YOUR NEXT CHAPTER
scenes.text: Real tools, sequential specialists, source-linked findings and a reviewable draft. All test students in this demo are fictional.

trim: Only the final 1.96 seconds of the closing hold were trimmed; no research waits were shortened.
